    Search Jobs

    Benchmark is looking for passionate, curious problem-solvers to join our global team focused on technology and innovation. Benchmark operates across North America, Europe, and Asia, offering a collaborative work environment that values continuous improvement and aims to deliver exceptional products and services.

    CAREERS AT BENCHMARK

    Do you have a passion for technology?

    Are you curious by nature?

    If you thrive on solving problems and enjoy creating solutions for tough challenges, Benchmark may be just the place for you. As an employee of Benchmark, you’ll be a part of a global, collaborative team working to achieve incredible technological feats, deliver great products, and provide best-in-class service.

    SEARCH JOBS

    Our Purpose

    We innovate for a healthier, safer, and better-connected world to create a brighter future.

    Joining our Talent Network will enhance your job search and application process. Whether you choose to apply or just leave your information, we look forward to staying connected with you.

    Culture

    Inclusion

    We believe that when every team member feels seen, heard, and valued, we create a stronger, more collaborative, and innovative workplace. Our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment empowers everyone to bring their unique perspectives and talents to the table, driving our shared success. Explore how our focus on inclusion shapes our culture and fuels growth for both our people and our company.

    Why Benchmark?

    As a part of the Benchmark team, you will know that your work makes a difference. Our mission is to be the solutions provider of choice for high-technology original equipment manufacturers, anticipating their needs and rapidly delivering comprehensive value-creation solutions during the entire product life cycle from initial concept to full-scale production and after-market services. We’re committed to our foundation of financial strength, managerial integrity and a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. Technology doesn’t slow down, and neither do we. With your skills and expertise, our team makes the impossible possible.

    SEARCH JOBS
    Our mission is to be our customers’ trusted partner; providing comprehensive solutions across the entire product lifecycle; leading through our innovative technology and engineering design services; leveraging our optimized global supply chain; and delivering world-class manufacturing services.
